high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post from the user "thespacemate." The post includes a map of Africa with a highlighted green area indicating the proposed route of the Great Green Wall of Africa. The map shows the extent of the wall stretching across the continent, from the Atlantic Ocean on the west coast to the Red Sea on the east coast. The text accompanying the image reads: "More than 20 African countries have joined together to plant a giant wall of trees that will run across the continent to stop the spread of the Sahara Desert.
